                      coalesce(sum("__ledger_group_count"-1) FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND NOT ("account_code" IS NULL OR "account_name" IS NULL OR "department" IS NULL OR "pl_category" IS NULL OR "pl_subcategory" IS NULL OR "project" IS NULL OR "region" IS NULL OR "report_month" IS NULL)),0),count(*) FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND ("account_code" IS NULL OR "account_name" IS NULL OR "department" IS NULL OR "pl_category" IS NULL OR "pl_subcategory" IS NULL OR "project" IS NULL OR "region" IS NULL OR "report_month" IS NULL)),
                      coalesce(sum("__ledger_group_count") FILTER(WHERE "__ledger_group_count">1 AND ("account_code" IS NULL OR "account_name" IS NULL OR "department" IS NULL OR "pl_category" IS NULL OR "pl_subcategory" IS NULL OR "project" IS NULL OR "region" IS NULL OR "report_month" IS NULL)),0)
